data.command: Do you have any databases accessible?

data.text:
We've got a MariaDB setup on this server, specifically version 10.5.11-0ubuntu0.22.04.1, running on the default port 3306. Our database server is listening on `127.0.0.1` and `::1`, the IPv4 and IPv6 loopback addresses, so only local connections are accepted.

The MariaDB installation is quite standard, with the default configuration file located at `/etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/50-server.cnf`. We're using the `unix_socket` plugin for authentication, which allows users to connect using their system credentials.

As for the database itself, we've got a single instance running, with the database named `mysql`. The default `root` user has a password set, but I've also created a new user `myuser` with the password `mypass` for the sake of our current project. If you need any further details or have specific requirements, just let me know!
